To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed and validated a rapid and reliable multiplex PCR method to identify the structural types of the complex mec element in methicillin-resistant S. aureus.

we developed a multiplex PCR method for rapid identification of structural types and variants of mec element carried by methicillin-resistant S. aureus and that we validated and applied this method to the characterization of MRSAs recovered during an outbreak in Spain.
a multiplex PCR assay was developed and validated that allows rapid identification of five structural types of mec elements in MRSA.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR) strategy that allows the rapid presumptive identification of the major and minor variants of the mecA gene and the mec complex carried by methicillin-resistant staphylococcal strains.
the characterization of the genetic background and of the mec element structure of methicillinresistant Staphyococcus aureus ( MRSA ) strains.

the development and validation of a multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR) strategy that allows rapid presumptive characterization of methicilline-resistant Staphyloccocus aureus (MRAS) isolates based on the genetic features of the mec complex, which is associated to the drug resistance gene mecA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the mecA-positive S. aureus isolates can be grouped into 11 types (I to XI) on the basis of their multilocus sequence types and the structural types of the associated mec element, which is a prerequisite for a more detailed characterization and understanding of the evolution and dissemination of these important pathogens.
a multiplex PCR method for mec element characterization was developed, tested, and validated, and it is now ready for use in routine clinical practice.

a combination of the multiplex PCR strategy with multilocus sequencing typing and other molecular typing methods should provide a rapid and comprehensive tool for the characterization of epidemic MRSA clones.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the multiplex PCR is a rapid, robust, cost-effective tool for the characterization of the structural types and variants of the mec elements among MRSA strains, and it can be used as a complementary tool in the typing of MRSA clones and in the epidemiological surveillance of MRSA.
a rapid multiplex PCR strategy has been developed for the presumptive identification of the structural type and variants of the complex and heterogeneous mec elements carried by MRSA.
a multiplex PCR method for the characterization of mec element types was developed and validated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a rapid and robust method is now available for the presumptive identification of major structural types of the complex and highly heterogeneous mec elements that are carried by MRSA.
multiplex PCR is a useful tool for rapid characterization of methicilli-resistant Staphyloccocus aureus.
the multiplex PCR strategy is a useful addition to molecular typing tools for characterization of MRSA clones and for rapid tentative identification of variants of the mec complex.
